evals.prompt: 审查/优化网站的 UI、布局、响应式、交互体验。
evals.expected_output: Understands content before design, runs an evidence-based browser audit (viewport matrix, computed styles, overflow, contrast), proposes design direction and gets approval before code.

evals.prompt: 卡片内的编号和别处不一致，请保持一致。
evals.expected_output: Checks the whole structural family for SAME STRUCTURAL PATTERN, not just the symptom element; proposes the pattern fix.
assertions: Audits the whole family, not one element
Fixes structure, not just the visible symptom

evals.prompt: 在保留品牌的前提下重新设计这个站，先分析再改。
evals.expected_output: Produces the four-part review (assessment / direction / structure / plan) with measured evidence, then explicit decision points before implementation.
assertions: Embeds core principles (content first, no fake precision)

evals.prompt: 320 宽度下横向溢出，只在菜单打开时出现。
evals.expected_output: Opens every disclosure/dropdown at each collapsed-nav width and measures bounding rectangles; verifies scrollWidth and per-element overflow.
assertions: Checks open-state overflow, not just closed pages
Measures bounding boxes at narrow viewports

evals.prompt: 审计中英文档对的一致性。
编辑了 .NET 工程，跑构建门禁。
定义 UI 交互协议契约矩阵。
